runtime_observations: Backend identity must be derived per origin; the inventory tag 'custom' carries no field prior. Use the per-origin form_shape above only as a hint.
Required-ness: rely on '*' in label/heading text; the required attribute is absent on most bespoke forms.
Never fill honeypots ('Leave this field empty', trailing 'Website' inputs).
Exclude non-application forms by submit text and by form_index != 0 heuristics; several pages have search/newsletter forms first.
Amazon 'Apply now' anchors and Built In anchors resolve to gates/redirects; follow with a GET in the owned tab, then re-observe.

inferred.malemd_unverified: The 10 questions are likely narrative (page: 'so we can get a real read on your work'); expect 1 question per screen with auto-save.
inferred.rocketalumni_unverified: 'Start interview' suggests an async video/text interview step.
inferred.remotivate_unverified: Recruiter-intermediary flow; later steps likely include screening questions and consent to share with the end client (UTM.io).

provider_hint.for_jev: custom backend: no shared schema. Read the rendered form; identify the application form by its submit text, exclude search/newsletter forms and honeypots. Required = '*' in label text. Classify each control: fact_copy (name/email/phone/linkedin/location), file (resume/cover letter with accept list), option_choice (state/position/source/availability from verified facts), eligibility/attestation (in-office, schedule, accommodation, work authorization -> verified fact or human), free_text_narrative (route to writer with the exact prompt and length cap). For multi-step apps stop before the first control that transmits data ('Start Application', 'Send Application & Move to the Next Step', 'Start interview', 'Next').
option_choice_from_verified_facts: position applying for (must equal the posting)
experience bands and ad-spend bands (Digital Neighbor) only if verified facts exist

edge_cases: Corporate Tools has two templates for the same employer: apply-now/?j= (custom comboboxes, no required attrs, no '*') and apply/?id= (native selects, '*' markers). Same questions, different control families.
Stratabeat's marketing opt-in checkbox sits inside the application form and is easy to mistake for a consent attestation.
Goliaence's single checkbox bundles work authorization AND hybrid-schedule acceptance; a truthful answer requires both facts.
Digital Neighbor's LinkedIn URL input reported has_value=true on a blank form (likely a default prefix); the runtime must not assume prefilled fields are candidate data.
Remotivate's CV accept list includes JPEG.
